falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,150 (August 2024 swing low) at any point in next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 76% pattern match to bottom_2024_aug is broken; new lower low invalidates the bottom formation and suggests continuation lower, not a bottom

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Blowoff score of 40 implies controlled volatility; sustained VIX >35 indicates panic selling and capitulation, invalidating the 'HOLD' signal which assumes stabilization

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.50% (a 50bp+ decline from current levels)
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Flight-to-safety of this magnitude indicates recession fear or credit event, contradicting the macro bottom thesis which requires stable/rising rates reflecting soft-landing confidence

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
